key_evidence: Proposal 1: Adoption of the Merger Agreement. Board recommendation: FOR.

If the Merger is completed, each share of Innovid common stock will be canceled and converted into the right to receive cash in an amount equal to $3.15 per share, without interest, unless you have properly exercised your appraisal rights.
This amount represents an approximately 94% premium to the closing price of Innovid common stock of $1.62 per share on November 20, 2026.

Shareholder vote outcome and any supplemental merger disclosure.
